blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) formally turned over a Patient Transport Vehicle (PTV) to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on October 5, 2026, to strengthen its patient transport capabilities and support its medical, humanitarian, and emergency response operations.
